title: Catgirl Delivery Scene
description: A surreal triptych scene shows three young women in cat-themed outfits. On the left, a brunette in pink bikini and bandana sits cross-legged on a bed taking a selfie in a messy pink bedroom. In the center, a blonde catgirl in pink off-shoulder top holds a cardboard box beside a red mailbox. On the right, a woman with short black hair in striped purple outfit kneels on a stone path in front of a large pink Gothic cathedral.
prompt: A surreal composite scene divided into three parts with soft glowing edges. Left panel: brunette woman wearing pink bikini, black bandana with white dots and cat ears sitting cross-legged on a bed covered in pink patterned sheets, taking a mirror selfie in a messy pink bedroom with posters and laundry. Center: blonde catgirl with pink off-shoulder crop top and tail holding a cardboard Amazon box next to a bright red mailbox, wearing cat ear headband. Right panel: woman with short black hair in purple and black striped long-sleeve crop top and matching pants kneeling on a stone path in front of a large ornate pink Gothic cathedral at sunset, all rendered in realistic digital painting style with warm cinematic lighting.
